title: Campaign Asset Workflow Automation
description: Designed and developed an Electron desktop application that helps internal teams organise hundreds of campaign assets. Users can create folder structures, configure string-matching rules, preview generated folders in File Explorer and export organised assets to a chosen location.
impact: Automated a previously manual campaign asset workflow.

title: Asset Management Application
description: Built an Electron-based internal asset management application to streamline production workflows. Added automated testing with Vitest and Playwright alongside Azure Pipelines with build caching.
impact: Reduced manual asset processing requirements by 90%.

title: Interactive Product Finder
description: Developed an interactive product recommendation experience for Croydex, combining dynamic filtering, guided measurement flows, AR model viewing and analytics instrumentation across desktop and mobile.
impact: Helped customers navigate product selection with clearer guidance.

title: In-store Video Experience
description: Engineered a mobile-first story-style video experience for Currys' in-store QR journey, with gesture navigation, video playback controls and event tracking for a smoother product discovery flow.
impact: Created an interactive product experience for mobile retail journeys.

title: Retail Product Experiences
description: Delivered responsive product pages and static content experiences for major UK retailer platforms, with a focus on performance, accessibility and consistent behaviour across devices.
impact: Supported product launches and customer education journeys.
